moves.name: Jab 3 (Gentleman)

moves.name: Neutral Special (Air, Start)
notes: FAF here is the animation's length: the motion list sets no cancel frame for this action, so the true actionable frame may be earlier.

Landing lag is 9 frames, from `param_special_n.landing_frame`. This special has no landing animation of its own — it hands the figure to the landing directly — so nothing in the script or the motion list shows it.

moves.name: Neutral Special (Air, Loop)
notes: Held: the animation loops, so this ends on release or on a state change rather than on a fixed frame.

Land cancels: touching the ground during this move ends it in Neutral Special (Landing), which recovers in 9 frames and is the only way out of it. The figure is param_special_n.landing_frame, which is what that status becomes actionable on -- its animation runs longer.

moves.name: Air Dodge
notes: FAF is HDR's runtime calculation rather than a param: the air dodge stalls for 28 frames and ends once the fighter has fallen 35 units, so it follows their gravity and fall speed.
Intangible on frames 4-26.
Landing lag is 10 frames, from common's `landing_frame_escape_air` — the param HDR's air dodge status hands the landing when the dodge ends on the ground.
